preprocessing: Raw data are cropped by event markers and filtered at 1-40 Hz with an IIR band-pass (there is no additional DC-offset subtraction). Robust bad-channel detection (|robust z(SD)|>6 or SD<0.1 uV) and montage-based interpolation are then applied, followed by average A1/A2 rereferencing, resampling to 250 Hz, and per-lap Infomax ICA. ICA targets 99% explained variance with a minimum of two components when a one-component solution would otherwise result, and uses fixed eye/muscle rules with at most two exclusions. No resting-state baseline subtraction or power normalization is applied. A1/A2 are not model channels; the surviving signal is converted from V to uV before feature calculation.
window_definition: Six non-overlapping sample-index windows per lap; bounds are numpy.linspace(0, n_times, 7, dtype=int), so adjacent windows cover the lap exactly and differ by at most one sample.

ICA targets 99% explained variance with a minimum of two components when a one-component solution would otherwise result, and uses fixed eye/muscle rules with at most two exclusions. No resting-state baseline subtraction or power normalization is applied. A1/A2 are not model channels; the surviving signal is converted from V to uV before feature calculation.
window_definition: Six non-overlapping sample-index windows per lap; bounds are numpy.linspace(0, n_times, 7, dtype=int), so adjacent windows cover the lap exactly and differ by at most one sample.
spectral_estimator: scipy.signal.welch on uV data, Hann window, nperseg=min(500, N), default 50% overlap, density scaling; band power is trapezoidal integration over [low, high).

ICA targets 99% explained variance with a minimum of two components when a one-component solution would otherwise result, and uses fixed eye/muscle rules with at most two exclusions. No resting-state baseline subtraction or power normalization is applied. A1/A2 are not model channels; the surviving signal is converted from V to uV before feature calculation.
window_definition: Six non-overlapping sample-index windows per lap; bounds are numpy.linspace(0, n_times, 7, dtype=int), so adjacent windows cover the lap exactly and differ by at most one sample.
spectral_estimator: scipy.signal.welch on uV data, Hann window, nperseg=min(500, N), default 50% overlap, density scaling; band power is trapezoidal integration over [low, high).

ICA targets 99% explained variance with a minimum of two components when a one-component solution would otherwise result, and uses fixed eye/muscle rules with at most two exclusions. No resting-state baseline subtraction or power normalization is applied. A1/A2 are not model channels; the surviving signal is converted from V to uV before feature calculation.
window_definition: Six non-overlapping sample-index windows per lap; bounds are numpy.linspace(0, n_times, 7, dtype=int), so adjacent windows cover the lap exactly and differ by at most one sample.
spectral_estimator: scipy.signal.welch on uV data, Hann window, nperseg=min(500, N), default 50% overlap, density scaling; band power is trapezoidal integration over [low, high).

ICA targets 99% explained variance with a minimum of two components when a one-component solution would otherwise result, and uses fixed eye/muscle rules with at most two exclusions. No resting-state baseline subtraction or power normalization is applied. A1/A2 are not model channels; the surviving signal is converted from V to uV before feature calculation.
window_definition: Six non-overlapping sample-index windows per lap; bounds are numpy.linspace(0, n_times, 7, dtype=int), so adjacent windows cover the lap exactly and differ by at most one sample.
